svg.aria-label: Harsha Pilli, Java and Spring Boot developer in Halifax, Nova Scotia. Three years of production delivery before a Master of Applied Computer Science at Dalhousie University. 535 unit tests on one project, 50 REST endpoints, 85 percent coverage at work. Projects: Collabry, SmartCare, an open pull request against OpenMRS Core, and DCode. Available for a 4 or 8 month developer co-op from January 2027, open to relocation anywhere in Canada.

not after it. Now completing a Master of Applied
Computer Science at Dalhousie University in Halifax.
